title: Improve Razorpay checkout experience for desktop and mobile users

requirements.text: Add a device detection utility that distinguishes between mobile and desktop users based on user agent and/or screen width, and export it for use in Razorpay checkout flows.

quotes: Detect whether the user is on desktop or mobile

acceptanceCriteria: The utility correctly identifies mobile devices (phones/tablets) vs. desktop browsers.
The result is available to all components that initiate Razorpay checkout.

requirements.text: Update the Razorpay checkout configuration in `frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts` and any direct checkout calls in `frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx`, `frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx`, and `frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx` so that: on desktop, the Razorpay modal opens with `config.display.preferences.sequence` prioritising cards, then net banking, then UPI QR code (method: 'upi', flow: 'qr'), and the UPI collect/intent flow is disabled; on mobile, the existing flow is preserved with UPI apps (intent), cards, and wallets as primary options.

quotes: On desktop, show a UPI QR code (instead of collect request) along with cards, net banking, and wallets as primary options
Mobile: Keep the existing smooth flow with direct UPI app options (Google Pay, Paytm, PhonePe), cards, and wallets

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, the Razorpay modal shows Cards as the default/first tab, followed by Net Banking and UPI QR code.
On desktop, the UPI collect (push request to phone) flow is not presented to the user.
On mobile, the Razorpay modal shows UPI app options (Google Pay, Paytm, PhonePe intent), cards, and wallets as before.
Payment completion and order creation still work correctly on both device types after the change.

requirements.text: Ensure the Razorpay checkout modal is responsive and well-styled for both mobile and desktop screen sizes — no clipped elements, appropriate modal width on desktop, and full-screen/bottom-sheet style on mobile if supported by Razorpay's config.

quotes: Responsive, clean modal styling for both screen sizes

acceptanceCriteria: On desktop, the Razorpay modal is properly sized and centered without overflowing the viewport.
On mobile, the modal displays correctly without layout issues.
No visual regressions on existing cart/product pages.

constraints: Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Razorpay Standard Checkout script is already loaded via frontend/index.html — do not add a duplicate script tag.
Backend order creation and payment verification logic must remain unchanged.
nonGoals: Replacing Razorpay with a different payment provider.
Adding new payment methods not already supported by Razorpay (e.g., BNPL).
Changes to the backend Razorpay key storage or order creation flow.
Any changes to Stripe checkout flow.
